R1.description: Home shows 'Last backup N days ago' with a 'Back up' link when the last backup is 21 or more calendar days old, and 'No backup yet' with the same link when there has never been a backup and the first finished workout ended 21 or more calendar days ago; the line goes away once a backup is exported

R2.description: The line never shows while a workout is running, on a phone with no training data, or when the Backup reminder switch is off, and never blocks or covers anything

R3.description: Settings, under Your data after Backup and restore, has a Backup reminder switch, on by default including on an upgraded phone, and its value persists

R4.description: Back up opens Backup and restore and Back returns to Home; at font scales above 1.1 the link wraps to its own line and nothing is clipped, in light and dark
